description: This file defines a SwiftUI view called SettingsTab, which provides a comprehensive settings interface for an iOS application related to OpenClaw, including gateway management, device features, and onboarding controls.

classes.name: SettingsTab
classes.description: A SwiftUI View struct that provides a user interface for configuring app settings, networking, gateway management, device features, and onboarding controls within an iOS app.

classes.name: FeatureHelp
classes.description: An internal struct used to represent help information for certain features, identifiable by a UUID for display purposes.

methods.name: gatewayList
methods.description: Displays a list of available and connected gateways based on the current filtering mode.

methods.name: featureToggle
methods.description: A helper method to generate a toggle UI element with an info button and help message.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Asynchronously initiates a connection to a given discovered gateway, handling the connection process and updating UI state.

methods.name: connectLastKnown
methods.description: Asynchronously attempts to reconnect to the last known gateway.

methods.name: gatewayDebugText
methods.description: Generates a debug string summarizing the current gateway and discovery status logs.

methods.name: lastKnownButtonLabel
methods.description: Builds the label UI for the last-known gateway connection button.

methods.name: syncManualPortText
methods.description: Synchronizes the manual gateway port text input with the current port number state.

methods.name: applySetupCodeAndConnect
methods.description: Processes the entered setup code, applies necessary configurations, and initiates connection to the gateway.

methods.name: applySetupCode
methods.description: Decodes and applies the setup code, extracting host, port, and tokens, updating relevant settings.

methods.name: applySetupURL
methods.description: Parses a URL from setup code and updates manual gateway host and TLS preference accordingly.

methods.name: resolvedManualPort
methods.description: Determines the effective manual port based on user input and TLS rules.

methods.name: preflightGateway
methods.description: Performs a TCP reachability check to the gateway address and port, verifying connectivity.

methods.name: probeTCP
methods.description: A static helper that probes TCP connectivity with a specified host, port, and timeout.

methods.name: connectManual
methods.description: Initiates a manual connection to a host and port configured in the settings.

methods.name: setupStatusLine
methods.description: Provides a user-readable status line for gateway setup status.

methods.name: tailnetWarningText
methods.description: Returns a warning message if Tailscale is off on the device but the gateway hostname suggests a tailnet host.

methods.name: friendlyGatewayMessage
methods.description: Translates raw gateway status strings into user-friendly messages.

methods.name: hasTailnetIPv4
methods.description: Checks if any active network interface has a tailnet IPv4 address.

methods.name: isTailnetHostOrIP
methods.description: Determines if a host string belongs to the tailnet IPv4 range or domain suffix.

methods.name: isTailnetIPv4
methods.description: Checks if an IPv4 address falls within the tailnet-specific range.

methods.name: parseHostPort
methods.description: Parses a host and port from an address string.

methods.name: httpURLString
methods.description: Generates an HTTP URL string based on optional host and port, with fallback.

methods.name: resetOnboarding
methods.description: Resets onboarding state, clears credentials, and disconnects the gateway, preparing for a new onboarding process.

methods.name: gatewayDetailLines
methods.description: Constructs detailed info lines about a discovered gateway for display.
